w20.portrait:
Create an original studio facial casting triptych for a grounded medieval fantasy RPG. Beautiful physically based DIGITAL HUMAN portraits, the aesthetic of Unreal Engine 5 MetaHuman in a high-end real-time close-up, strand groom, soft micro-facial hair, subtle skin subsurface scattering, convincing wet eyelid meniscus and tearline, restrained corneal specular, natural cheek volume and asymmetry. Neutral broad soft window-like key and warm grey seamless background common to all three. Restrained filmic exposure, true skin colour, no exaggerated wrinkles or dirt, no sharpening halo, no wax, filters or illustrative brushwork. Three clearly UNRELATED, distinctive human actors, using different facial anatomy, gaze and expressions. Do not morph the same base face. Arrange as a wide 3-column triptych, only one person per third, camera at eye level facing nearly head on, each framed entire crown to clavicle at the same scale. All eyes clear, face unobscured. Timeless handmade medieval workwear visible just at collar: dark indigo A, leather brown B, weathered linen C. No modern items, no costume armor. Good looking playable leads, no makeup glamour, no uniform scowl. Identity direction, strictly left to right:
A 22-year-old woman, pale olive complexion, broad-set softly hooded brown eyes, short tilted nose, strong dark unibrow with a small natural break, round full lower lip, short botticelli curls, focused curiosity; slightly raised single brow.
B 25-year-old woman, deep umber complexion, full cheeks with a dimple only on the left, wide rounded nose, pronounced cupid's bow, small deep-set eyes that narrow as she grins involuntarily at someone, natural coils gathered low.
C 28-year-old woman with tawny freckles, long narrow nose that veers a little to her right, thin upper lip, widely spaced green eyes under almost invisible auburn lashes, straight strawberry-blond hair, relaxed watchful gaze.
At rest capture a fleeting human reaction, avoid exaggerated or caricatured expressions. Three equal head and shoulders portrait panels touching, no text or labels, no secondary images.
w20.fullLength: Create a single coherent front-facing FULL BODY lineup for Veles, an original grounded dark-fantasy RPG, in high fidelity Unreal MetaHuman-style digital human rendering. Reference 1 is the identity lock: cast the precise three individuals in their existing left-to-right order. Faithfully match their face shape, mouth, eyes, nose, pigmentation, hairstyle, apparent age and subtle characteristic expression. Avoid face averaging. Reference 2 is costume, relative body sizes and equipment only. Three women, ages 22, 25, 28. Left: slender erect and tall survey instrument maker, long fitted indigo coat, pear-shaped plumb bob, holding a straight wooden scale staff with a small OPEN RECTANGULAR BRASS SIGHT on top. Center: shorter, muscular wide-set bell founder, dark leather shoulder mantle, well-used russet work apron, bare forearms, bronze bell at hip and squat hammer. Right: agile coracle builder with simple linen shirt, carrying two curved bent-ash boat ribs to one side, beautiful open negative space visible. Balanced front-on standing poses. Same even warm-grey ground and soft studio light across lineup. One full body per third. Exact frontal view with both shoulders evident, full crowns and boots in frame, common floor plane. Realistic natural human proportions and compelling unforced faces. Only three standing figures, exactly once each, no inset portraits, no extraneous text/headings. Wide landscape format.
